correctness.rationale: The overlap graph has four pair states; a closed labelled walk is equivalent to a periodic predecessor, including ring lengths one and two. Full 16-bit Boolean-relation closure yields 735 states. The supplied independently executable Python code checks, in exact integer arithmetic, the 735-component identity \(\sum_{j=0}^{34}q_jT^{40-j}h=0\), where Q is the product of six explicit polynomials. Applying T repeatedly gives the recurrence for every length \(n\ge40\), not just the tested range. Both the proposed log-derivative expression and the derived image series have common denominator Q and numerator degree <=39; all 40 initial coefficients agree exactly. Independent forward image enumeration at every ring length 1..14 crosschecks the boundary convention. The proof does not rely on empirical interpolation or floating point.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general method for counting preimages of a fixed finite word is not a formula for the count of distinct periodic outputs. It would require finding which fixed-period words have a closed predecessor walk, resolving duplicate labels and summing over every period. The 735-relation recurrence and factorized expression carry out this extra calculation. Neither general symbolic dynamics nor a change of rule aliases removes that specific result.

originality.rationale: The checked accessible earlier work includes Jen (1989) on linear/infinite-lattice finite-window preimage recurrences (Rule 73 listed in its telescoping class), Wolfram (2002) on Rule-73 dynamics, Kang (2013) on long-distance Rule-73-like automata, and a recent finite cyclic Garden-of-Eden census. None of the material actually inspected states or implies without new nontrivial calculation the exact factorized degree-34 denominator, all-length periodic image counts, and 735-state integer relation certificate. The finite census covers the same output statistic at specific lengths but not the asserted infinite formula. Search failures are not proofs of novelty; unindexed older work remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: Negative index and literature search does not establish global historical uniqueness. Other unindexed earlier works may contain the same exact rational function.

Wuensche and Lesser (1992) and later finite-basin monographs were not inspected in full; known finite basin tables would not by themselves imply an all-length rational identity, but an explicit analytic formula there would require recomparison.
The 2026 CA Zoo dynamic table was not extracted as a full table; no absence claim is made about any external unpublished underlying data.
The Kang manuscript was read only at abstract level, because its explicitly stated long-distance dynamics is not the same primary model.
Chua (2009) Volume III contains Rule-73 finite basin diagrams but its full contents were not accessible for exclusion of a coincident all-length formula.

value.rationale: The exact all-length cyclic image size is a canonical inverse-reachability invariant for the much-studied elementary Rule 73, whose domain-wall and complex special-input behavior make finite-period image compression a meaningful structural question. The theorem gives a nontrivial explicit rational series (degree-34 denominator) and rigorous exact counts at arbitrary length, beyond a finite census and beyond a generic automaton construction. The specific integer vector identity and factored log-derivative reduction supply mathematical structure suitable for further finite-ring information-loss analysis. It does not claim a general classifier for all elementary rules, nor treat a short-table extension as the contribution.
